effects: The signer sends msg.value of native ETH to the WETH contract (payable, deposit()).
The signer's WETH balance is credited with exactly msg.value (balanceOf[msg.sender] += msg.value), 1:1, no fee.
formats.shown: Intent "Wrap" with one field, Amount = the ETH value sent (e.g. "0.00187 ETH").

findings.title: deposit(): bare intent "Wrap" names neither ETH nor WETH, and there is no interpolatedIntent.
findings.evidence: descriptor.json display.formats["deposit()"]: intent "Wrap", no interpolatedIntent. WETH9.sol deposit(): balanceOf[msg.sender] += msg.value. Case 0 mined: ETH 0.00187 out, WETH 0.00187 credited to signer. The blind reader wrote "Presumably 0.00187 WETH ... (the screen doesn't state it)".
findings.fix: Set intent to "Wrap ETH to WETH" and add interpolatedIntent "Wrap {@.value} ETH into WETH" so the sentence names the asset that arrives and the amount.

cases.notes: ETH out 0.00187 is shown as the Amount field. The 0.00187 WETH received is only implied by "Wrap". The reader guessed it right but flagged it as unstated. Calldata has a stray trailing byte (0x76), which deposit() ignores, so it does not affect the screen.

effects: The signer's WETH balance is reduced by wad (it reverts if the balance is lower).
The contract sends exactly wad native ETH to msg.sender (the signer), 1:1, no fee.
formats.shown: Intent "Unwrap" with one field, Amount = wad shown as a WETH amount (tokenPath @.to, e.g. "0.040351608 WETH").

findings.title: withdraw(): bare intent "Unwrap" does not say ETH is received, and there is no interpolatedIntent.
findings.evidence: descriptor.json display.formats["withdraw(uint256 wad)"]: intent "Unwrap", no interpolatedIntent. WETH9.sol withdraw(): msg.sender.transfer(wad). Case 1 mined: signer gets 0.040351608 ETH in. The blind reader wrote "The screen doesn't state that ETH is received".
findings.fix: Set intent to "Unwrap WETH to ETH" and add interpolatedIntent "Unwrap {wad} to ETH".

cases.notes: WETH out 0.040351608 is shown with the right token. The ETH received (same amount, to the signer) is only implied by "Unwrap". The reader inferred it correctly but was unsure.

deposit().worst: deposit(): bare intent "Wrap" names neither ETH nor WETH, and there is no interpolatedIntent.

withdraw(uint256 wad).worst: withdraw(): bare intent "Unwrap" does not say ETH is received, and there is no interpolatedIntent.

summary.worst: deposit(): bare intent "Wrap" names neither ETH nor WETH, and there is no interpolatedIntent.
